surfaces.cachePolicy: analytics ingest is force-dynamic/no-store; client batches in memory and flushes on schedule/end.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: High-frequency interactions are batched; watch ticks are 5s minimum; semantic page summaries flush on exit.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: ANALYTICS_WRITE
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: recordClientDiagnostic, recordServerDiagnostic, analytics pipeline failure rollups
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: privacy consent gates anonymous and identified analytics before dispatch.

surfaces.cachePolicy: third-party analytics is client-only and consent-gated; no backend replay of PostHog payloads.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: High-frequency events must be sampled or routed through canonical backend rollups.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: client session budget plus privacy-consent gate
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: debug evidence only for failed integration wiring, not per-event logs
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: analytics provider env/feature flag must be absent-safe.

surfaces.cachePolicy: GA admin reads must use hot-cache/snapshot routes when quota-bearing.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: Only canonical semantic events and funnel milestones go to GA; dense interactions stay batched first-party context.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: GA Data API admin routes require admin analytics rate policies.
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: quota/failure evidence rolls into analytics pipeline health.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: GA measurement id absence disables dispatch.

surfaces.cachePolicy: disabled until a separate replay budget and privacy contract exists.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: 0% by default.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: not allowed until explicit replay budget guard exists
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: activation must emit admin-visible budget evidence.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: hard disabled by default; feature flag must be explicit.

surfaces.cachePolicy: diagnostic writes are append/rollup only and never cached into public payloads.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: Warnings/errors only; detail is capped to 20 fields and 500 chars per field.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: route-level guardApiRequest where diagnostics are user-triggerable
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: recordRouteDiagnostic mirrors sanitized debug evidence for actionable route failures.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: diagnostic write failures are swallowed and must not block user flows.

surfaces.cachePolicy: rollup by fingerprint with bounded event document writes.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: same-fingerprint repeats roll up after per-hour event-write cap.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: ANALYTICS_WRITE on /api/debug/evidence
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: fingerprint rollups plus redacted audit summaries
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: debug evidence write failures return null and never block user flows.

surfaces.cachePolicy: private/no-store for protected content; static public covers use image-loading policy.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: track approximate access counts, not raw URLs.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: MEDIA_PROXY or admin/creator equivalent rate policy
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: content-protection failures feed route diagnostics without leaking asset URLs.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: admin/content routes must stay admin-only; locked media path must fail closed.

surfaces.cachePolicy: signed URL redirects require explicit expiration; proxy streams must be no-store/private.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: telemetry stores assetKey/fileId/mediaIndex only, never raw content URLs.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: MEDIA_PROXY for viewer media and admin/user scoped guards for document URLs
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: media access failures record redacted route evidence.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: allowed media host check and entitlement check before redirect/proxy.

surfaces.cachePolicy: above-fold images are eager/preloaded sparingly; grids and below-fold assets are lazy.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: image diagnostics are source-level by default, not browser snapshots.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: image proxy/media routes use existing route guard policies
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: image loading failures should use capped diagnostics.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: remote image domains must stay allowlisted.

surfaces.cachePolicy: auth mutation routes are no-store/dynamic.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: fake/bot signup velocity rolls into admin review, not per-attempt noisy logs.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: STRICT/STANDARD/RELAXED auth route policies with trusted origin
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: auth abuse/failure evidence is sanitized and capped.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: expected auth failures return typed safe errors without expensive retries.

surfaces.cachePolicy: disabled until SMS budget contract exists.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: QA must use fictional test numbers only.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: SMS budget guard plus strict per-IP/per-account abuse limit before enablement
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: SMS budget and abuse evidence must be admin-visible.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: hard feature flag disabled by default.

surfaces.cachePolicy: notification reads use private revalidate; writes are admin-only and idempotent.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: broadcasts dedupe by idempotency key and cap recipients/batches.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: STANDARD/HEAVY_READ route policies plus admin guard for fan-out
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: broadcast report includes success, failure, skipped, duplicate, and invalid-token counts.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: browser push disabled per user by preference and fan-out caps stop unbounded sends.

surfaces.cachePolicy: CI uses npm cache and lightweight source checks by default.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: browser/full-suite jobs are default-off and explicit only.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: GitHub workflow concurrency and least permissions where possible
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: CI failures are workflow artifacts, not runtime debug writes.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: heavy jobs must be workflow_dispatch or explicit command only.

surfaces.cachePolicy: public stable assets cache intentionally; private/user routes stay no-store.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: source validators before browser traffic generation.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: API routes behind hosting use route-level guards.
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: hosting bandwidth warnings stay in docs/report evidence.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: deployment commands are forbidden by default agent lane.

surfaces.cachePolicy: build artifacts are not committed and are cleaned before completion.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: no automatic image/build artifact publication from validators.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: workflow permissions are read-only except explicit release-note update workflow.
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: artifact cost notes live in generated reports/docs.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: deploy/publish commands are forbidden by default.

surfaces.cachePolicy: snapshots are explicit-command only and must declare a snapshot budget.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: source dry audits run before visual snapshots.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: command budget requires explicit user request or critical uncertainty.
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: snapshot reports are local artifacts and must not be committed unless intentional.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: forbidden in default CI and default agent verification lane.

surfaces.cachePolicy: browser audit artifacts are local and cleaned before completion.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: deterministic source validators first; browser audits only by explicit escalation.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: affected audit command budget
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: browser audit failures are report artifacts, not runtime telemetry.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: not present in lightweight CI default commands.

surfaces.cachePolicy: scheduled runs use bounded source windows and status documents.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: hourly schedule has retryCount 0; manual wrappers expose dry-run/max rows/runtime budgets.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: cron/manual execution only, no every-commit rebuild
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: status docs and logger summaries record bounded results.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: dry-run flag and maxRuntimeMs stop local/manual runs from mutating unexpectedly.

surfaces.cachePolicy: materialized analytics snapshots are bounded by max event/watch/guest/feedback limits.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: materializers process recent bounded windows and write capped user/drop/session docs.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: manual/scheduled only; no default CI or every-commit rebuild
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: materializer status/failure docs and logs are capped.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: dry-run/max rows/max runtime source-visible wrappers.

surfaces.cachePolicy: dependency tooling uses GitHub/npm caches; no auto-merge.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: minor/patch grouping and report-only scorecard.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: Dependabot grouping and PR review gates
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: dependency review output remains CI evidence.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: no auto-merge or deploy from dependency updates.

surfaces.cachePolicy: exports/imports are admin-only and must be dry-run/idempotent before mutation.
surfaces.samplingPolicy: bounded rows, resumable cursor, explicit mutation estimate.
surfaces.requiredRateLimit: ADMIN/HEAVY_READ or stricter route policy
surfaces.requiredDebugEvidence: admin-visible import/export status, failures, and cost estimate.
surfaces.requiredKillSwitch: dry-run default and explicit owner approval before mutation.

hardLimits: No 1s watch/session telemetry ticks; visible ticks must be 5s or slower and flush at end/visibility hidden.
Debug evidence dedupes by fingerprint and caps event document writes per fingerprint per hour while rolling up repeats.
Cloud/server logging redacts sensitive fields, caps detail previews, and avoids full request/response payloads.
Media and signed-url routes require entitlement, MEDIA_PROXY-style rate policy, no-store/private cache, TTL or proxy policy, and no raw asset URL telemetry.
Auth/signup/login/reset surfaces require trusted-origin and abuse/rate policies; future phone auth requires an SMS budget guard.
Notification fan-out requires idempotency, batch caps, recipient caps, retry caps, and duplicate prevention.
Browser audits and visual snapshots are default-off in CI unless explicitly requested with a budget.
Rebuild/materializer/import/export jobs require dry-run, maxRows, maxRuntimeMs, bounded retries, and cost estimates before mutation.
PostHog/GA/session replay use route/session budgets; session replay remains disabled unless explicitly enabled with a budget.
forbiddenCommands: visual snapshot tests without explicit budget
